metadata.title: QEC v170.3.0 Independent Verification Package: Exact Ququart Frame-Error Rate and Harmonic Receiver Evidence
metadata.description:
This record formalizes an independent execution and evidence review of the QSOLKCB/QEC v170.3.0 ququart frame-error-rate (FER) battery at pinned commit dada8b7a20a75753db43acc01a6a9e723ebaa6b6.

A full-depth checkout passed the complete available pytest suite with 19,172 tests passed, zero failures, four expected optional-backend skips, and four warnings. The focused ququart FER battery passed 18 of 18 tests. The evidence package contains exhaustive classification of all 16^5 = 1,048,576 packed Pauli patterns for the packed [[5,1,3]]_4 code, deterministic Monte Carlo results over four declared channels, a deterministic harmonic receiver fault matrix, a 28-cell end-to-end harmonic battery, claim-validation artifacts, raw logs, source report files, and SHA-256 manifests.

The corrected statistical audit finds that 38 of 40 Wilson 95% intervals contain the exact FER: all 20 zero-event cells and 18 of 20 nonzero-event cells. Two misses are consistent with expected interval noncoverage and low-count fluctuation. The deterministic harmonic fault battery records 375 adversarial evaluations with zero false accepts and zero receiver false-trust events.

Scope is limited to exact finite-code capacity analysis and deterministic classical harmonic-readout simulation. No hardware threshold, fault-tolerance threshold, quantum advantage, circuit-level performance, leakage, SPAM, pulse-fidelity, or physical-device claim is made.
metadata.notes: The autonomous executor and AI reviewer are recorded as computational contributors. Trent Slade is the citation creator and package curator.
